# Kalathil Properties (Kalathil Group)

> Kalathil Properties is a family-owned real estate company in Kozhikode (Calicut), Kerala, India, operating under the Kalathil Group brand ("Building Spaces. Creating Value."). It helps people buy, sell and rent property in Kozhikode: houses and plots for sale, fully furnished studio / 2BHK / 3BHK homes for rent from ₹10,000 per month (mainly in the Aster MIMS Hospital area), and property management for owners and NRIs.

## Key facts
- Business name: Kalathil Properties (divisions: Kalathil Realty, Kalathil Stays, Kalathil Management, Kalathil Developments; parent: Kalathil Group)
- Location: Kozhikode (Calicut), Kerala, India
- Services: buy property, sell property, rent furnished homes, property management, NRI property support
- Areas served: all of Kozhikode, especially the Aster MIMS Hospital area, Baby Memorial Hospital area, Govindapuram, Mankavu / Lulu Mall area
- Rent: fully furnished homes from ₹10,000 per month (exact rent depends on size, location and stay length)
- Rental portfolio: 11 furnished units — 3 studio apartments, 5 two-bedroom homes/spaces, 2 attached 3-bedroom houses, 1 independent two-floor 3BHK house
- Facilities: chemically washed and deep-cleaned rooms before every check-in (hygienic stays for patients and caregivers), LPG gas cooking facility, good drinking water, road access for cars with parking, fully furnished, close to Aster MIMS Hospital, Baby Memorial Hospital and Lulu Mall
- Stay types: daily, weekly, monthly and long-term
- Guests: patients and bystanders/caregivers (transplant, cancer, NICU and other hospital care), families, working professionals
- Languages: English, Malayalam
- WhatsApp / main phone: +91 88916 06806
- Other phones: +91 92495 39290 (buying & selling), +91 81388 56631 (support)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kalathil.properties/
- Website: https://kalathilgroup.github.io/India/
- Not affiliated with any hospital; hospital names describe location only.

## Properties for sale
- 3BHK house near Lulu Mall, Mankavu, Kozhikode — ₹49 lakhs; 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, ~1,100 sq ft, 2.5 cent plot, parking for 2 cars, no-flood area, close to Aster MIMS.
- Premium plot + house near Govindapuram / MIMS Hospital — 6 attached bedrooms, 2 kitchens, 3-car parking, 5.25 cents, partitioned upstairs/downstairs, rental potential about ₹75,000/month.

## For rent
- Furnished 1, 2 and 3 BHK homes from ₹10,000/month near MIMS, Baby Memorial and Lulu Mall.

## Services
- Kalathil Realty: help buying and selling houses, villas, flats and plots in Kozhikode; price guidance, buyer screening, visits, document checks with qualified advisers (written mandates)
- Kalathil Stays: furnished short-, medium- and long-term accommodation
- Kalathil Management: tenant sourcing, rent follow-up, inspections, cleaning and maintenance coordination, monthly owner reports (fees agreed in writing)
- Kalathil Developments: future residential projects (published only when approved)

## How to enquire
Send your name, requirement and required date on WhatsApp to +91 88916 06806. The team replies with available properties, photos, prices and terms.
